Mark the student's response to a question from the 2022 NSW HSC Ancient History exam strictly against the official marking criteria, exactly as an HSC marker would: award marks only for what is actually written, do not be generous, and quote the criteria row the response fits. 5–6 marks: Presents a sound explanation relevant to the question | Refers to relevant source(s) | Communicates ideas using appropriate historical terms and concepts
3–4 marks: Presents some information relevant to the question | May refer to a relevant source | Communicates ideas using some historical terms and/or concepts
